∀ (k : Type) [inst : Field.{0} k] [IsAlgClosed.{0} k] (n : Nat) [inst_2 : Quiver.{0, 0} (Fin n)]
  [inst_3 : (a b : Fin n) → Decidable (Nonempty.{1} (Quiver.Hom.{0, 0} a b))],
  Etingof.QuiverUndirectedConnected n →
    Iff (Etingof.HasFiniteRepresentationType k n)
      (And (∀ (v : Fin n), IsEmpty.{1} (Quiver.Hom.{0, 0} v v))
        (And (∀ (v w : Fin n), Nonempty.{1} (Quiver.Hom.{0, 0} v w) → Nonempty.{1} (Quiver.Hom.{0, 0} w v) → False)
          (And (∀ (a b : Fin n), Subsingleton.{1} (Quiver.Hom.{0, 0} a b))
            (Etingof.IsDynkinDiagram n (Etingof.quiverUndirectedAdj n)))))

∀ (k : Type) [inst : Field.{0} k] [IsAlgClosed.{0} k] (n : Nat) [inst_2 : Quiver.{0, 0} (Fin n)]
  [inst_3 : (a b : Fin n) → Decidable (Nonempty.{1} (Quiver.Hom.{0, 0} a b))],
  Etingof.QuiverUndirectedConnected n →
    Iff (Etingof.HasFiniteRepresentationType k n)
      (And (Etingof.IsOrientationOf.{0} inst_2 (Etingof.quiverUndirectedAdj n))
        (And (∀ (a b : Fin n), Subsingleton.{1} (Quiver.Hom.{0, 0} a b))
          (Etingof.IsDynkinDiagram n (Etingof.quiverUndirectedAdj n))))

source_text: For connected finite quivers, finite representation type is independent of the orientation and occurs exactly when the underlying graph is Dynkin.
